name: @red-cup-engineering/colony-report-service
description: Folds activity reports from any number of named providers over one exact (fromExclusive,toInclusive] interval into one colony report with summary metrics, and wraps that fold in the digest-bound ColonyCivicIntervalReport contract for any colony, whose identity is the colonyKind parameter rather than a compiled-in colony name.

scripts.check: node --check src/colony-report.mjs && node --check src/default-colony-report.mjs && node --check scripts/save-and-read-colony-report.mjs
